verdict.scam.brand: This is a scam: it does not come from {brand}.
command.owner_only: Only the business owner can do this.
enroll.ask: Hi, I'm VIGIA. To enroll your business send: hello <business name> <country>. For example: hello Corner Hardware US
enroll.done: Done: {business} is enrolled and you are the owner. Add your team with: team +1 202 555 0100 Name. From now on, forward me anything suspicious.
enroll.already: You are already enrolled in VIGIA. Send help to see the commands.
team.added: {name} is now on your team and can forward me suspicious messages.
contact.taken: That number or email is already enrolled in VIGIA.
email.code_sent: I sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Whoever gets it must reply from their WhatsApp: code 123456. It expires in 15 minutes.
email.code_body: Your VIGIA code is {code}. Reply on WhatsApp with: code {code}. It expires in 15 minutes.
email.verified: Email verified. You can now forward suspicious emails to VIGIA.
email.code_invalid: That code is not valid. Check it or ask for another with: my email you@email.com
email.code_rate_limited: I did not send the code: that address or your business already got several codes in the last hour. Please wait a while and try again.
email.code_locked: Too many attempts with a wrong code. That code no longer works; request a new one with: my email you@email.com
email.code_none: I have no pending code for you. Ask for one with: my email you@email.com
supplier.added: Supplier {name} saved to your address book.
history.empty: Your business has no verdicts yet.
help: VIGIA commands: forward me any suspicious message to check it. history: last 5 verdicts. my email you@email.com: link your email. Owner only: team +1 202 555 0100 Name [email] and supplier Name email=... account=...
case.empty: Forward me the suspicious message (text, screenshot, voice note, PDF or email) and I will tell you if it is a scam. Write help to see the commands.
case.unsupported: I can't check this kind of file yet. Send me text, a screenshot, a voice note, a PDF or an email.
